title: A Garden for the Summer
author: Mara Almeida
blurb: August Vane, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
